answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 34892 Country: India Title: Is Fashion Designing Course permissible for girls? Question: Is Fashion Designing Course permissible for girls? Answer ID: 34892 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1810/1454/B=1432) If it is merely for learning then there is no harm provided you will not have to make the design of any living being.
